items.name: Quarry-Oath Ring
items.lore: Every quarryman of Grimspound wears one. It is cut from the same block as the giants' standing stone.

items.name: Heartstone Pendant
items.lore: A sliver of the giants' heartstone. It grows heavier when you lie.

items.name: Jory's Chisel-Pin
items.lore: A mason's chisel, its edge filed down into a bracer-pin. It still bites.

items.name: Granite-Weave Mantle
items.lore: Grey cloth that falls in stiff folds like rock. Giants will not strike someone who wears it - or so the story goes.

items.name: Golestandt Scale Brooch
items.lore: A sliver of dragon scale the size of a thumbnail. It is still warm, weeks later.

items.name: White Hart Mantle
items.lore: Sir Wystan's own cloak, singed at the hem.

items.name: Ash-Grey Signet
items.lore: A dragonslayer's ring, its stone gone milky from the heat.

items.name: Slayer's Vow-Belt
items.lore: Every notch a vow. Some of them are crossed out.

items.name: Ember-Heart Bracer
items.lore: A bracer of blackened bronze that the dragon's breath could not melt.
